cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've signed where you made that mark. Joint borrowers. Will you co-sign for this barbecue?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was an ink test. I'll help carry it, but the handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pen's working. Sign as joint custodian; we'll inspect it together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're co-chair of replacements. I'll call the shops; you approve what we buy before we promise her anything.

reason: A mistakes an ink test for borrowing procedure and covers by officially recruiting B. Keep inspection and replacement purchasing as actual shared tasks rather than role slogans alone.
